newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-MAN DIES AS BATTLES MAR FEYENOORD MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAN DIES AS BATTLES MAR FEYENOORD MATCH.

text.p: Feyenoord's success in drawing level with Dutch league leaders PSV Eindhoven on Sunday was overshadowed when one died and dozens were injured in battles between rival fans.

Feyenoord went joint top by beating lowly AZ Alkmaar 2-0. But some of their supporters concentrated instead on a pre-arranged battle away from the ground against fans of traditional rivals Ajax Amsterdam.
Police said the rival groups used mobile phones to arrange the fight and outwit police attempts to prevent it.
Hundreds armed with baseball bats, clubs and knives streamed to waste ground along the A9 motorway near Amsterdam for a showdown ahead of Feyenoord's match away to AZ Alkmaar.
The two top teams each have 58 points from 26 matches but PSV stay in first place because of a better goal difference.
Feyenoord took the lead against Alkmaar via a Henke Larsson header in the third minute and Gaston Taument added the second in the 76th.
Feyenoord's chance to go level on points came because PSV had suffered their first home defeat of the season on Saturday, beaten 1-0 by Heerenveen.
Jon Dahl Tomasson, leading goalscorer in the Dutch league and on the shopping list of Ajax Amsterdam, scored the only goal of the match to take his tally to 17 for the season.

Ajax, European Cup quarter-final winners against Atletico Madrid in midweek, were without injured skipper Danny Blind and winger Tijjani Babangida but they had little trouble beating bottom of the table RKC Waalwijk 2-1.
All the goals came in the second half with Richard Witschge opening the scoring a minute after the interval with a chip from 40 metres over goalkeeper Rob van Dijk.
In the 61st minute Danny Muller levelled for RKC, shooting home a rebound after goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar failed to hold a Clyde Wijnhard shot.
But two minutes later Frank de Boer scored his second of the season from a free kick.
Defending champions Ajax have a match in hand but trail PSV and Feyenoord by 13 points.
